data.description:
## Observation
During `make verify` at 1bfa37ca141 with host load average about 44, 2 tests failed and then passed 3 of 3 in isolation: `tests/interfaces/store/test_bridge_sync_holds_ref_lock.py::test_bridge_sync_honours_an_active_pause` (`cannot pause bridge: git rev-parse --verify timed out after 5.0s (fail-closed: treat as HELD)`) and `tests/interfaces/facades/test_plan_review_attestation_facades.py::test_cli_passed_but_unsigned_is_exit_11_with_byte_identical_stderr` (`OSError: [Errno 48] ... address already in use` binding 127.0.0.1:55506).

## Expected
Neither test depends on host load: no fixed 5 s subprocess budget in a test path, and no fixed or reused loopback port.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each failure is reproduced deterministically (injected slow git; a pre-bound port) and fixed at its class.
data.title: Two tests fail under host load: a 5 s git timeout and a fixed loopback port
